brief: @buildthis.bisks.net Simcluster Prince of Persia. scrolling platform game where you navigate a dungeon playing as a crow character who pecks characters to attack them. have the "guards" drawn from pfps of users followed by @norvid-studies.bsky.social. look up Prince of Persia images online to design
